source.source_locator: 教則 第5章 5.2.1(2)1)「離着陸地点の選定」（教則表示ページ57 / PDF viewer 63）

evidence.answer_defining_proposition: ヘリコプターの離着陸地点は水平・非滑性を確保し、砂や乾燥土による視界悪化を避ける。
evidence.tested_misconception: 回転翼機なら地表状態は離着陸安全性に大きく影響しない。
evidence.reasoning_path: helicopter rotor/downwash/ground contact -> site surface hazards -> select safe surface

collision.note: LOW。既存Riskの一般的離着陸場所選定とは異なり、ヘリコプター固有の傾斜・滑り・砂埃を問う。

independent_review.rationale: 5.2.1 requires helicopter takeoff/landing sites to be level, non-slippery, and to avoid sand/dry soil due downwash visibility risk. Existing helicopter/Risk coverage addresses area size, isolation, ground effect and wind, not this surface-condition proposition.

director_adjudication.rationale: The independent review is source-consistent with the current MLIT 第5版 Chapter 5, preserves second-class scope, and correctly isolates one semantic duplicate. The other 19 candidates test distinct operational process, insurance/security, GNSS-off control, aircraft-specific takeoff/landing technique, human-error mitigation, CRM-skill, and assistant-role propositions with useful practice value. Near-neighbor candidates C004, C012, C014 and C020 remain distinct from the cited canonical questions because they require different causal or operational decision boundaries.
